description: This file defines an interface 'ValueYModifiable' within the namespace OrangeHRM\Core\Report\FilterField. The interface specifies a method yValueModifier for modifying or preparing a 'y' value for persistence, which is used in the context of report filter fields within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: ValueYModifiable
classes.description: An interface that mandates implementing classes to define the method yValueModifier for processing `y` values before persistence.

methods.name: yValueModifier
methods.description: Method to implement custom logic for modifying or processing the `y` value before saving or using it. Accepts a nullable string and returns a nullable string.
